title: NFL WEEK 7 BETS: Patriots-Bears, Chiefs-Seahawks, Cowboys-Eagles, Bengals-Ravens, Packers-Lions
transcript_summary: Chad Millman and Simon Hunter preview the NFL Week 7 betting board on Sharp or Square, evaluating line movements, professional vs. public money, and matchup spot angles. Simon selects the Buccaneers +3.5 as his 'Simon Says' pick, while Chad chooses the Falcons +3.5 as 'Chad's Choice'.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Welcome to Sharp or Square, presented by Polymarket, part of The Volume Podcast Network. I am Chad Millman, joined as always by professional bettor Simon Hunter.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Chad, how are we doing?

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: We are off a 4-1 week in the contest. Great week for the show. Double-digit lead comebacks and variance in NFL games are making every week volatile.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: If you're complaining about double-digit comebacks or bad beats on social media, you are an amateur bettor. A bet isn't over until the game is officially done.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: We benefited from it with the Browns, Commanders, and Steelers. It shows how much variance exists in the NFL right now.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: People who complain about losing late leads don't understand that variance works both ways. The NFL is a brutal sport to bet, so stay level-headed.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Let's touch on NFL futures and updated market sentiment before diving into the Week 7 game breakdown.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Right now my biggest futures position adjustments involve NFC teams like Green Bay, where I might look to take a position.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Starting with Thursday Night Football: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears (-3). Line opened 2.5 and moved to 3 on professional money.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: There's line value here at 2.5 for Chicago, but if it pushes to 3.5 due to Patriots injuries, Vrabel as a hook dog is where you'd want to be.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: The Bears defense was dominant with Kyler Gordon back, while New England's offensive line is depleted with injuries.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Next game: Pittsburgh Steelers (-3.5) at New Orleans Saints in Paris. Line moved from Steelers -2.5 up to -3.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: International games have seen favorites underperform recently. I'll take a small piece of Saints +3.5 with the hook, but not a huge play.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: New York Giants at Houston Texans (-9.5). Line opened 9 and pushed to 9.5 and 10 in places. Why are the Texans favored by so much?

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: The oddsmakers are begging people to take the Giants as a public dog. Smart money drove Houston up because they expect Houston's defense to dominate.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: The Giants can score late or blow up depending on who plays quarterback, making this line tricky despite Houston's defensive ranking.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers (-3.5). The line is Panthers -3.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Simon Says: Give me the Bucs +3.5 on Polymarket.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Division dogs in this series have been strong. Carolina's offense has been solid, but Tampa Bay as a dog with a 3.5 hook is attractive.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: These division rivals always play close games decided by 3 points or less. Getting +3.5 with Tampa Bay is key value.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Promotional segment for Polymarket trading platform.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: San Francisco 49ers (-3.5) at Atlanta Falcons. Falcons are +3.5 home underdogs.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Chad's Choice: Falcons +3.5. Fading teams that have been covering by large margins works statistically.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Pro money is heavily on Atlanta, driving the line down to 3 at several books. The 49ers' receiver injuries make 3.5 a great grab on Atlanta.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Cleveland Browns (-1.5) at Tennessee Titans. Line dropped from 2 to 1.5 with sharp interest on Tennessee.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: I have to bet Tennessee here as a home underdog against a Browns team that the public is overvaluing after last week's comeback.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: The public is heavily backing Cleveland, but sharp groups are taking Tennessee.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Cincinnati Bengals at Baltimore Ravens (-2.5). Opened 3.5, immediately bet down to 2.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: We both liked Bengals +3.5 on Sunday night. At +2.5 now, the value is diminished unless Lamar Jackson is ruled out.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Joe Burrow's late-game turnovers make backing Cincinnati stressful, but the line movement shows respect for the Bengals.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets (-4.5). The Jets are 4.5-point favorites coming off Miami's bye.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: System plays back Miami off the bye week. Line is inflated at 4.5; Miami +4.5 is a situational bet.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Indianapolis Colts at Minnesota Vikings (-6.5). Line opened 6, dipped to 5.5, now up to 6.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: The matchup is terrible for Indianapolis against Minnesota's blitzing defense. I bet Colts +6 early, but Minnesota looks like the right side now.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Kyler Murray and KOC have momentum out of the bye week, making Minnesota a tough opponent for an unstable Colts team.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Denver Broncos (-4.5) at Arizona Cardinals.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: I don't understand this line being 4.5. Bo Nix hasn't shown enough to justify Denver being over a field goal road favorite. Lean Cardinals +4.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions (-3). Packers are a heavy public underdog.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: If this reaches +3.5 for Green Bay, I'll take the Packers. Jordan Love is playing at an elite level, making Green Bay attractive as a dog.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Los Angeles Rams (-4.5) at Las Vegas Raiders. Line dropped from 6 down to 4.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: The Rams are banged up and struggling defensively without key pieces. I bet Raiders +6 on Sunday and still like Raiders +4.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Kansas City Chiefs at Seattle Seahawks (-2.5). Seattle is favored by 2.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Getting Patrick Mahomes as an underdog or teasing Kansas City +8.5 is incredible value. Seattle's offense has been way too inconsistent.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Seattle's inability to run the ball forces Sam Darnold into turnover-worthy plays, favoring Kansas City here.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Monday Night Football: Dallas Cowboys (-4.5) at Philadelphia Eagles.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: The line of 4.5 is too high given Dallas's defensive collapse. Fading Philadelphia in the second half has worked all year, but taking Eagles +4.5 at home makes sense.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Recapping our main plays: Simon Says Buccaneers +3.5, Chad's Choice Falcons +3.5. We'll finalize the contest picks on Thursday's show.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Simon Says official pick. Division rivalry games in this series are historically decided by 3 points or fewer.

extracted_picks.speaker: Chad Millman
extracted_picks.rationale: Chad's Choice official pick. Fading 49ers after inflated covers; 55% historical system trend backing home dogs in this spot.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Leaning Saints +3.5 in an international game in Paris where favorites have underperformed.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Sharp money taking Tennessee against a Cleveland team the public is overvaluing after a comeback win.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: System play backing Miami coming off a bye week against an inflated Jets line.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Denver should not be a 4.5-point road favorite with Bo Nix struggling downfield.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Rams are heavily damaged by injuries; Raiders +4.5 offers value against an underperforming Rams squad.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Incredible value on Mahomes as an underdog or teased up to +8.5 against an erratic Seattle offense.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: 4.5 points is too high for Dallas on the road given their leaky secondary.

analysis_notes.summary: Bears defense looked vastly improved with Kyler Gordon returning, making 17 snaps count for 3 sacks and 2 forced fumbles. Meanwhile New England is playing behind a third-string offensive line.
analysis_notes.speaker: Chad Millman
analysis_notes.quote: The problem for the Patriots, they're basically playing all backup linemen.

analysis_notes.summary: Books are begging public bettors to take the Giants at +9.5 / +10, but sharp money pushed Houston up expecting a low-scoring blowout.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: The books I feel like are telling on themselves a little bit here.

analysis_notes.summary: 49ers wide receiver injuries force Brock Purdy to rely heavily on Christian McCaffrey out of the backfield, limiting vertical chunk plays.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: Tons of injuries to the wide receiving corps of that team.

analysis_notes.topic: Sam Darnold Turnover Concerns in Seattle
analysis_notes.summary: Sam Darnold's propensity for turnovers in high-leverage spots hurts Seattle's offensive efficiency compared to the steady baseline Drew Lock provided last season.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: Sam Darnold is consistently losing them games. He is turning the ball over.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Simon Hunter
quote_timestamps.quote: Simon Says give me the Bucs plus 3 and a half.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Chad Millman
quote_timestamps.quote: Atlanta Falcons plus three and a half, that is going to be Chad's Choice.
